lines.en: I step into the clinging marsh.
Each foot is sucked by mud.
I drag my legs forward.
Marsh bubbles burst at my feet.
I creep forward along the reed roots.
Sticky threads hang on my shell.

lines.zh: 我慢慢绕过倒下的树干。
lines.en: I round a fallen trunk.
Shallow pits print the mud.
I creep forward low.
The gas makes my head swim.
I stop at a pool's edge.
I follow the reed line.
My steps raise a string of bubbles.
I set a foot on a grass root.
I wade half submerged.
I haul onto firmer ground.
I lie still in the mud.
Mud coats my plates.
I listen to the gas gurgle.
The weeds cover my back just right.
My mouthparts grind slowly.

lines.zh: 一只蜻蜓落在我的背上。
lines.en: A dragonfly lands on my back.
I wait for movement in the mud.
The marsh shows my reflection.

lines.zh: 我把前肢在水里洗了洗。
lines.en: I rinse my forelimbs.
I know this marsh well.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像是块木头。
lines.en: I stay still as a log.
I slowly lift my antennae.
Your boots are sinking.
This isn't a place for walking.
You stepped on my mud.
I've waited here a long time.
Can't pull your foot out, can you?
What you hold will sink.
Few come to this marsh.

lines.zh: 你靴底的干土，掉在我沼地上了。
lines.en: The dry soil on your boots fell into my marsh.
I crawl slowly toward you.
Don't thrash, you'll sink deeper.
Marsh water seeps into the crack in my shell.
I sink into the mud.
Muddy water got in the wound.
I can still crawl with this.
I'm soaked through.
I spit out a bit of mud.

lines.zh: 黏沼泽的泥，把我这六条腿粘住了。
lines.en: Sticky marsh mud clogs these six legs.
I sink half an inch.
Step again and I sink into the mud.
I haven't reached the bottom yet.
Is that alive?
Drop it in the mud and it's mine.
Sweetness in rotten water; strange.
Lower it — I can't reach.
I inch my way over.
Things in the mud are better.
Don't put your hand in the water.
That will soak and rot.
Dry things will not go down.

lines.zh: 黏沼泽的水拖住我的脚。
lines.en: The sticky marsh drags at my feet.

lines.zh: 你的靴跟碾过我的节肢。
lines.en: Your heel grinds across my segmented leg.
I'm pressed into the mud.
Mud splashed your trouser leg.
Back off, it's all soft here.
I slip, then grab the grass.
You broke the marsh bubbles.
My shell is slick; your foot will slip.
That bump is nothing.
You nearly flattened me.
Crowd me and I'll sink.
I'm alone in this marsh.
That waits until the water falls.
I'm covered in mud.
First, don't sink.
I prefer the quiet.
Find one elsewhere.
Even walking is hard for me.
The reeds would watch.
Don't bring it up, I'm hungry.
I'm going under.
Something hard in the mud.
I dig it out with my forelimbs.

lines.zh: 黏沼泽里，什么都能沾住。
lines.en: In the sticky marsh, everything clings.
It's swollen from soaking.
I'll keep what fell.
Mud has covered it.
I press this wad of muck under my belly.
This weighs little.
I drag it slowly to my burrow.
No one comes to steal here.
Your feet won't come free.

lines.zh: 你站在我触须的长度里。
lines.en: You stand within reach of my feelers.
I keep very low.
You're standing on my mud.
The water swallows my sound.
The harder you pull, the faster you sink.
I will wait for you to sink.
Deep water is behind you.
I come slowly.
The marsh helps me.
You can't lift your weapon.
Then let it open.

lines.zh: 黏沼泽的泥，粘住我的脚。
lines.en: Sticky marsh mud clings to my feet.
Don't shout, the mud swallows it.
I close in from behind the reeds.
The mud is slowing your steps.
My shell matches the mud.
The rustling under the mud is me.
That was only a bubble.
I'm at your flank now.
Your feet will never come free.
You can barely move in the mud.
There are no paths in the mire.
Only the tracks I left.
I count the second time.
You're nearly done.
I move now.
You can't turn in time.
My pincers clamp into your ankle.
My forelimbs hook your trouser leg.
I drag your leg deeper into the mire.
You fall in with a splash.
My strength isn't heavy.
You tore free of me.
I sink back under the mud.
Blood spreads in the marsh.
You'll struggle even to stand.
After the bite, I shrink back into the reeds.
The mud bulges. It's me.
A new line of bubbles in the marsh.
I crawl out from under the reeds.
Muddy water drips from my shell.
No one has cleared this marsh.
Mud water slides off my back plate.
Marsh gas spreads around me.
The reeds stirred.
I wait for prey in these wetlands.
I lie low, hidden in the mud.
Fire hits my wet shell and steams.
I fall from the reeds into mud.
Muddy water clogs my mouthparts.
Mud sprays everywhere.
That sank into my soft shell.
Magic locks me stiff.

lines.zh: 沼里的东西越来越少了。
lines.en: The marsh offers less and less.

lines.zh: 雷打在湿泥上，我全身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning hits wet mud, my body jerks.
No mud to hide in, in the void.
